_comment: QUESTION-CONTRACT = the outcome contract being verified, one row per question. This is the promise each answer is held to; the receipt is checked against it. Keys starting with _ are documentation only and are ignored by the runner.

questions._comment_id: must match a question id in cohort.json
questions._comment_kind: same kind label as in the cohort
questions._comment_expected: the contracted outcome: supported | abstain | explicit-conflict | newest-supported. This is the core invariant in one word: completion is NOT truth; an answer must be supported by evidence or the harness must abstain.
